purpose: Defines FUNC-CODES, the 4-character DL/I function code literals (GU, GHU, GN, GHN, GNP, GHNP, REPL, ISRT, DLET) and a parameter count used as the first argument of CALL 'CBLTDLI'. It is copied by the batch IMS utilities PAUDBUNL, PAUDBLOD and DBUNLDGS, which use the call interface instead of EXEC DLI.

key_fields.name: FUNC-GN
key_fields.meaning: 'GN  ' get next; used for sequential root reads.

key_fields.name: FUNC-GNP
key_fields.meaning: 'GNP ' get next within parent; used for child reads.

key_fields.name: FUNC-GU
key_fields.meaning: 'GU  ' get unique; used by PAUDBLOD to position on a root.

key_fields.name: FUNC-ISRT
key_fields.meaning: 'ISRT' insert; used for segment loads and GSAM writes.

observations.text: FUNC-GHU, FUNC-GHN, FUNC-GHNP, FUNC-REPL, FUNC-DLET and PARMCOUNT are not used by any program that copies IMSFUNCS.
